subject: The one mistake 90% of users make on day one
preview_text: It's not downloading the app. It's skipping this 30-second setup that unlocks everything. Don't be them.
body_paragraphs: I watched a user yesterday. Downloaded the app, looked at the home screen, and closed it. They missed the whole point. It's like buying a Ferrari and never turning the key. The magic isn't in having the app. It's in the first 30 seconds of using it.

Here's the secret: The AI doesn't just transcribe. It learns. Your first meeting summary is its training ground. It figures out your jargon, your team's names, what 'action items' look like to YOU. That first summary is the cheat code. Skip it, and you're just using a fancy recorder. Do it, and you've got a personal note-taking assistant that gets smarter every time.

So here's your 30-second win: Open the app right now and hit the big red button. Record 60 seconds of ANYTHING—a podcast clip, a YouTube video, even you talking to your dog. Let the AI transcribe it and generate a summary. That's it. You've just trained your personal assistant. Now it knows your voice.

Do that one thing now. I'll wait. Seriously, open the app and hit record. I want you to feel that 'holy crap, this actually works' moment before your next meeting. P.S. The first user who did this just emailed me. Saved 3 hours on meeting notes this week. Your turn.
cta_text: Open Smart Notes & Hit Record Now
